column1: # Host capabilities the sealed suite depends on, and the EXACT units bound to
# each one. tests/host-capability-gate.sh reads this file; the structural guard
# in tests/fm-host-capability-gate.test.sh pins it against the real call sites
# and against a literal count, so this set cannot grow or shrink in silence.
#     PLATFORMS is a comma-separated list of `uname -s` values that CAN provide
#     the capability. A platform outside the list skips; a platform inside it
#     RUNS the unit, and the unit FAILS if the capability is really missing.
#     LABEL is the enclosing shell function name, or `whole-file` when the whole
#     test file is gated. It must match the second literal argument of the
# An environment that runs on a listed platform but still cannot provide a
# capability declares that absence itself, by name, in
# FM_TEST_HOST_CAPABILITIES_ABSENT. That declaration is REFUSED on Darwin: on a
# Mac these units always run, so a broken Mac goes red instead of quiet.
